description: Frostfire Shoulderpads Level 60 Archmage Angela Dosantos at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make Frostfire Shoulderpads if you bring her the following: 1 Desecrated Shoulderpads, 12 Wartorn Cloth Scraps, 2 Mooncloth and 3 Cured Rugged Hides. Requirements: - Desecrated Shoulderpads - Wartorn Cloth Scrap x 12 - Mooncloth x 2 - Cured Rugged Hide x 3
name: Frostfire Shoulderpads
